audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage of the chart is 'Skill 5/10' — all seven rows — in a matchup Garen wins 58.53% of over 2592 games. The full layer has no 2+ items row at all ('2+ items Unknown').
audit.why: The 'why' strings already spell out the real shape and match the packet exactly: Mel takes Level 1 with ranged poke, then 'Level 2 your Q silence flips it' and Garen holds every stage to First item, with 2+ items a genuine skill check. A flat Skill chart tells the player nothing and contradicts both the data and its own prose.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the chart to the packet as one atomic group: win[0..5], phases[0..5].side/rating, and created the missing phases[6] row with before:null.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY at 7/10 difficulty, and report[5].t gives Solar Snare a 14s cooldown.
audit.why: 58.53% is one of Garen's best lanes, not a 7/10. Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 — 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Set diff FAV / 4-10 with both summary strings, and rewrote report[5].t with the real cooldown plus the root-versus-slow distinction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Solar Snare is called 'her R' in two places (it is her E; Golden Eclipse is the R), and two fields say Rebuttal 'reflects your engage damage back onto you'.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects projectiles and prevents her taking damage. Garen throws no projectiles, so nothing comes back at him — what actually happens is that his whole burst window lands on nothing. Telling the player he will eat reflected damage makes him hold the combo he should be spending after the barrier drops. From the mirror: Decisive Strike breaks all slows, so Solar Snare's outer slow field is worthless against Garen while the centre root still holds — and Rebuttal has to go up before the silence lands, because afterwards the cast is denied.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, content.late, whys[6], wants.foe[1] and wants.foe[2].

notes: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 falling to 26s at rank 5 — by far the longest punishable cooldown in her kit and the real green-light for a commit; no in-band field existed to state it.
